title: Second Chance
text:
Attach to a non-leader unit.
Attached unit gains: “When Defeated: For this phase, this unit's owner may play it from their discard pile for free.”
rules:
“Play for free” ignores all resource costs, including the aspect penalty, but not other additional costs.
If the attached unit is played from the discard pile, it enters play as a new copy of that unit. If it is defeated again in the same phase, it cannot be replayed from the discard pile as the new copy does not have Second Chance’s ability.
